Google Cloud Learn with Communities

Google Cloud Learn with Communities is an initiative from Google Cloud that brings structured, hands-on cloud learning to students and developers through their own communities.

Instead of long lecture videos, you learn inside Google Skills — Google's official platform for cloud training. You spin up real Google Cloud environments, complete guided labs, and earn skill badges that go on your public profile. Every badge is proof you can actually do the work.

Once you enrol through GeeksforGeeks, you get access credits to get started for free, a curriculum picked for your track, and a community around you to keep the momentum going.

play_circleWatch the walkthrough — enrol, redeem your credits, and get started
routeHow it works

From Registration To Your First Badge

Five simple steps. Register through GeeksforGeeks, redeem your credits, and start learning.

1

Create A New Active Google Skills Account

Sign up for a NEW active Google Skills account with a fresh email, then set your profile to Public so you can share your profile URL. Watch how to make your profile public →

lightbulbOnly new accounts created after 15th September are eligible to receive skill badges — so make sure you sign up on a fresh account for the campaign.
2

Fill The Enrolment Form

Register through the GeeksforGeeks form. Pick your track, and enter GeeksforGeeks as your partner along with the referral code NRVC72. Developers (working professionals) also add their GEAR / developer profile URL. Watch how to fill the Enrolment Form →

3

Receive Your Enrolment Email

Once your enrolment is processed, you'll get a confirmation email with your unique access code.

confirmation_numberYou can also get your access code herearrow_forward
schedulePlease check 2 days after registering — access codes are generated in batches, so give it a little time before looking it up.
4

Redeem Your Access Code

Open an incognito window, follow the redemption link, and enter your access code. Sign in to Google Skills and you'll see 9 credits ready to go. Follow the walkthrough video →

priority_highYour access code is personal, works once, and can't be shared. Use the exact link from your email — searching the catalog won't work.
5

Complete Your First Lab & Keep Going

Open "A Tour of Google Cloud Hands-on Labs" and click Start Lab. Follow the steps, spend at least 6 minutes, and aim for a score of 100. When you're done, click End Lab — the 200 free credits are added automatically, no extra claim needed.

verifiedCheck your balance at skills.google/my_account/credits. Then work through your curriculum and rack up badges.

redeemHow To Claim Your Rewards

1

Complete 5 Google Cloud skill badges between 16th–20th October.

2

Share a public post about your 5 badges on LinkedIn and copy the post URL once it's live.

3

Submit the form here.

4

Our team will verify your entries — you'll receive your rewards within 15–20 business days after verification.

Questions, answered

Is there any group or channel which I need to join?expand_more
Yes, it is mandatory to join the official Telegram Channel. Join by clicking here.
What is the Google Cloud Learn with Communities campaign?expand_more
Google Cloud Learn with Communities is a campaign for students and professional developers to learn through Google Skills, complete recommended curricula and hands-on labs, and earn relevant Skill Badges.
Who can participate in the campaign?expand_more
The campaign is intended for Students and Professional Developers. Participants must self-attest their role as either "Student" or "Developer" while completing the enrolment form.
Which platform is used for the campaign?expand_more
The campaign is conducted on Google Skills.
What is this program about?expand_more
This is a collaboration between GeeksforGeeks (GfG) and Google Cloud Learn with Communities, where students and developers can enrol in Google Skill Badge programs, build their skills through hands-on learning, and unlock exclusive GfG rewards by completing the required badges and sharing their progress.
